name: Installer
purpose:
/**
 * Installer Gate
 * Handles plugin installation, update, removal and viewing for the SartajPHP framework.
 * It manages plugin registration files, menu files and cache lists.
 */

properties.name: myclass
properties.doc: /** @var string $myclass Gate Class Name Without Gate postfix */

methods.name: onstart
methods.doc:
/**
 * onstart
 * Initialize gate: authenticate, set master file and create FrontParser objects for installer, config and plugin view.
 * @return void
 */

methods.name: directoryCount
methods.doc:
/**
 * directoryCount
 * Count/list directories inside a source path.
 * @param string $src source directory path
 * @return array list of directory names
 */

methods.name: isPlugExist
methods.doc:
/**
 * isPlugExist
 * Check if a plugin exists in the plugin list.
 * @return boolean true if plugin exists
 */

methods.name: page_event_config
methods.doc:
/**
 * page_event_config
 * Handle plugin install event.
 * @param string $param plugin name
 * @return void
 */

methods.name: page_event_update
methods.doc:
/**
 * page_event_update
 * Handle plugin update event.
 * @param string $param plugin name
 * @return void
 */

methods.name: page_event_rmp
methods.doc:
/**
 * page_event_rmp
 * Handle plugin uninstall event.
 * @param string $param plugin name
 * @return void
 */

methods.name: page_event_vw
methods.doc:
/**
 * page_event_vw
 * Handle plugin view event.
 * @param string $param plugin name
 * @return void
 */

methods.name: page_new
methods.doc:
/**
 * page_new
 * Handle new page event.
 * @return void
 */

methods.name: page_event_view
methods.doc:
/**
 * page_event_view
 * Handle view event: show plugin view data.
 * @return void
 */
